types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.Main

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.checker.CheckerFailure
types.summary: A stable checker failure code with optional bounded diagnostic context.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.checker.CheckerFailureCode
types.summary: Stable failure codes shared by model-checker stages.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.checker.ExplorationCount
types.summary: A counted exploration metric.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.checker.ExplorationMetrics
types.summary: What a model checker explored to reach its verdict, as ADR 0008 defines it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.checker.ExplorationPhase
types.summary: How far a model checker got before its verdict was fixed.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.CommandDiagnostic
types.summary: Formats command failures without coupling diagnostics to picocli.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.DecodedInputRenderer
types.summary: Renders a decoded input independently of picocli command wiring.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.EnvelopeReport
types.summary: Renders a decoded corpus envelope and its expression as plain text.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ExportDbCommand
types.summary: `fuzztla export-db`: exports a corpus with `CorpusExport` (ADR 0009).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ExportDbReport
types.summary: Renders the outcome of a corpus export.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.FuzzTlaCommand
types.summary: The root `fuzztla` command: registers the subcommands and runs one command line.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.Glyphs
types.summary: Characters for the live diagram and change markers.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.HumanDuration
types.summary: Formats nonnegative durations as compact day, hour, minute, and second parts.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.HumanNumber
types.summary: Locale-independent numeric fields; compact counts occupy at most five columns.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.InitCommand
types.summary: `fuzztla init`: writes the default configuration of a new corpus and installs its libraries.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.KnownDefectReport
types.summary: Renders the known-defect signatures that match one decoded input: each signature's id, description, and references, and the subexpression it matched first, as TLA+.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.Precision
types.summary: How a reported value is rendered: exactly for scrollback, or bounded for live screens.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.PrintCommand
types.summary: `fuzztla print`: decodes a payload or corpus envelope and renders it, with the known defects it matches.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ProgressChanges
types.summary: Tracks changes and their direction for one refresh interval, using a caller-supplied monotonic clock.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ProgressLayout
types.summary: Pure, size-bounded flow and table layouts for the same statistics and styles.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ProgressScreen
types.summary: Owns the alternate screen: entering it, updating changed rows, and restoring scrollback.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ProjectDirectory
types.summary: Locates the FuzzTLA project directory that ships the signature databases and scripts.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ReportCommand
types.summary: `fuzztla report`: prints the instructions for writing a campaign report (ADR 0020).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ReportInstructions
types.summary: The text of `fuzztla report`.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RewriteReport
types.summary: Renders a metamorphic pair for triage (ADR 0016 §8): which side the checkers explore, the rules applied in order, and both sides.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunCommand
types.summary: `fuzztla run`: reads a corpus configuration and runs `WorkflowRunner` with live progress output.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunMetric
types.summary: Stable field identity, independent of screen coordinates or formatted text.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunOutput
types.summary: The output of one run: the command's configured writer and an optional live display in front of it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunPalette
types.summary: Capability-aware styles on the terminal's own palette and default background.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunShutdownHook
types.summary: Converts JVM shutdown into an interruption and waits for workflow exit persistence.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunTable
types.summary: Complete, exact statistics grouped by stage; suitable for scrollback and redirected output.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunTerminal
types.summary: Acquires the process stdout terminal for live progress when it is capable.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunText
types.summary: Shared field formatting; attributed text keeps terminal escapes out of width arithmetic.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunValue
types.summary: Unrounded, typed values used both for formatting and change comparison.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.RunView
types.summary: The statistics shared by live and final reports, without layout or terminal state.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.ShrinkCommand
types.summary: `fuzztla shrink`: reduces a metamorphic counterexample with `MetamorphicShrinker` (ADR 0016).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.TerminalAcquisition
types.summary: Acquires a live progress display for one run.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.cli.TerminalProgressDisplay
types.summary: Terminal mechanics of live progress: snapshots, change highlighting, resizing, and screen restoration.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.ArchModule
types.summary: The top-level packages of FuzzTLA and the modules each may depend on directly (ADR 0022).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.ArchRole
types.summary: Declares the `Role` of a top-level type for the architecture atlas (ADR 0022).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.Cleanup
types.summary: Best-effort I/O cleanup that retains the original failure and its suppressed diagnostics.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.Diagnostics
types.summary: Human-readable diagnostic formatting for failures.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.Digests
types.summary: SHA-256 identities for corpus payloads and external replay dependencies.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.EnumMaps
types.summary: Validated immutable copies of maps keyed by an enum, iterated in declaration order.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.ExprCounts
types.summary: The size of a piece of TLA+ code, the occurrences of each expression construct in it, and the occurrences of each edge between constructs.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.ExprEdge
types.summary: An edge of an expression tree between two constructs: `parent` applied to, or binding, an immediate subexpression that is the construct `child`.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.FileTrees
types.summary: File-tree operations shared by the corpus and by isolated worker processes.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.GeneratorAggregate
types.summary: Immutable generation counters shared by persisted statistics and invocation summaries.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.Key
types.summary: Marks a top-level type as one of the few that carry its package, so that the architecture atlas draws it in the package views (ADR 0022).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.Preconditions
types.summary: Shared validation of method and constructor arguments.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.Role
types.summary: What a type does in its package, as the architecture atlas shows it (ADR 0022).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.TemporaryDirectory
types.summary: Owned temporary storage, removed on normal and exceptional completion.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.ThrowingConsumer
types.summary: An operation on one value that may fail with a checked exception.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.common.ThrowingRunnable
types.summary: An operation that takes no value and may fail with a checked exception.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.CheckerProfile
types.summary: What differs between the configured model checkers: the defaults of their resource settings and the documentation of the settings whose meaning follows from the worker lifecycle.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.CheckerStageConfig
types.summary: Capacity and resource limits for one model-checker stage.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.ConfigException
types.summary: Reports invalid contents in a FuzzTLA configuration file.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.ConfigPaths
types.summary: Resolution of the file paths a configuration file names.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.ConfigSchema
types.summary: The declaration of every key in `config.toml`: where it lives, what it means, how its value is read, and how it is written back.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.ConfigTableBuilder
types.summary: Registers typed keys in document order, then snapshots them as an immutable schema table.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.ConfigValueType
types.summary: How the value of one configuration key is read from TOML and written back as TOML syntax.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.FuzzTlaConfig
types.summary: Complete configuration of input generation and workflow execution.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.GeneratorLimitSchema
types.summary: Declares and assembles the expression and module limit keys in the generator table.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.InputStageConfig
types.summary: The input stage's occupancy limit and the known-defect databases its admission consults.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.MetamorphicConfig
types.summary: The `[metamorphic]` table (ADR 0016 §7, ADR 0017 §1): what a `--how=mt` run reads besides the generator settings.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.MutatorConfig
types.summary: Generations, the quality gate's selection, and the mutator's share and operators (ADR 0010).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.OperatorLibraryConfig
types.summary: Source-only library settings.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.ParserStageConfig
types.summary: Capacity and timeout limits for the parser stage.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.PbtConfig
types.summary: Limits and collection-richness controls for property-based input generation.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.QualityGateConfig
types.summary: What the quality gate keeps of a settled generation (ADR 0010, ADR 0013).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.StageLimits
types.summary: The limits every configured tool stage takes: its result capacity and a per-input time limit.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.TomlConfig
types.summary: Reads and writes the strict `config.toml` format used by a corpus.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.config.WorkflowConfig
types.summary: Global and per-stage limits for the implemented fuzzing workflow.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.AggregationInput
types.summary: A logical corpus entry whose non-crash checker results are ready for aggregation.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.AggregationRecovery
types.summary: Recovers aggregate commits and inventories the aggregator's result directories.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.AggregationTransition
types.summary: Joins the checker copies of one logical input into one durable aggregator result.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CborMapWriter
types.summary: Collects the fields of one CBOR map so that its definite length is derived from what is written rather than maintained beside it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CborReader
types.summary: Reads one CBOR document of a corpus, checking its shape as it goes.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CheckerSet
types.summary: The checker branches a corpus runs: a non-empty set of checking stages, in stage order.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CheckingPolicy
types.summary: Which checkers a workflow run feeds and how the aggregator judges their verdicts.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusCbor
types.summary: The Jackson wiring shared by every codec of the corpus CBOR formats.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusDirectory
types.summary: Owns the on-disk layout and integrity checks for one FuzzTLA corpus.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusEntries
types.summary: Reads corpus entries and states what makes one valid: a decodable CBOR envelope holding an expression, a name that matches its payload digest, a payload the caller's validator accepts, and stage metadata consistent with the directory the entry sits in.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusEntryStore
types.summary: Admits generated payloads to the input stage and preserves the ones that broke the generator.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusEntryValidator
types.summary: Checks that a stored input is still one this FuzzTLA build can use.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusEnvelope
types.summary: Supported fields decoded from one corpus input envelope.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusEnvelopeCodec
types.summary: Reads and rewrites the `stages` metadata of a corpus envelope.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusException
types.summary: Reports an invalid corpus layout or corpus entry.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusFormatException
types.summary: Reports stored corpus data that does not follow the documented CBOR format.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusInput
types.summary: The required fields of one encoded corpus input.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusInputCodec
types.summary: Encodes and decodes an input's kind, generator payload, and admission metadata.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusInventory
types.summary: Immutable startup inventory used to seed stage queues and capacities.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusLayout
types.summary: Where one corpus keeps its files, how an entry is named, and how a file is written into it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusLock
types.summary: An exclusive corpus lock and its backing file channel, released together.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusPath
types.summary: A fixed path in the on-disk corpus layout.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusRecord
types.summary: A small corpus file that pins how the corpus's entries replay.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusRunStatistics
types.summary: Durable cumulative statistics that cannot be recovered cheaply from corpus entries.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusRunStatisticsCodec
types.summary: Encodes and decodes the aggregate workflow-statistics CBOR document.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusStage
types.summary: One implemented stage of the fuzzing pipeline, and the corpus directories it owns.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.CorpusVerdict
types.summary: A verdict supported by the implemented corpus stages.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.EntryName
types.summary: The identity of one logical corpus entry: the file name it keeps in every stage directory it passes through.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.EntryOrigin
types.summary: Which candidate source admitted an entry, as its generation metadata records it (ADR 0010, ADR 0016 §6).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.EntryProgress
types.summary: How far one logical entry has moved through the pipeline, and the single definition of the two questions generation scheduling asks of it (ADR 0010).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.GenerationMetadata
types.summary: Admission-time facts about one corpus input: the generation that admitted it, its PBT cohort and collection-richness score, and, for a mutant, the parent and operators it was derived from.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.GeneratorCrashRecording
types.summary: Result of trying to preserve a payload that crashed its generator.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.InputAnalysis
types.summary: Counts the evaluated nodes, expression constructs and construct edges of one stored input, and names the rewrite rules it applied, typically by replaying it through the generator.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.InventoryScan
types.summary: The second pass of startup recovery: validates every entry of a corpus in which no transition is half-finished, and reports what it holds.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.Mutation
types.summary: How a mutated input was derived: the digest of the parent it was mutated from and the operators applied to the parent, in order.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.Oracle
types.summary: How the aggregator judges the checker results of one entry (fuzzing-workflows.md §1.3, ADR 0016 §4, ADR 0019).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.ReplayedInput
types.summary: What replaying one stored input shows beyond its envelope.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.ShallowPattern
types.summary: A way in which a TLC run explored almost nothing, as the calibration table of ADR 0008 defines it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageEntryCounts
types.summary: How many entries one stage has produced under each verdict.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageMetadata
types.summary: Metadata recorded when one workflow stage finishes processing an input.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageRecord
types.summary: What a stage records about one input: its verdict, when it worked on the input, its failure classification when it classifies failures, and what it explored when it measures exploration.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageResult
types.summary: What one stage decided about one input, and the tool output kept for triage.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageScratch
types.summary: Corpus-owned transient storage for one stage during one workflow invocation.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageScratchSet
types.summary: The transient scratch directories of every stage that needs one, created and removed together.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StageTransition
types.summary: Moves one entry from a stage's input directory to the directory its verdict names.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StoreResult
types.summary: Result of attempting to add an input to a corpus.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.StoredEntry
types.summary: An entry file in one of the corpus's entry directories, listed but not read.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.Technique
types.summary: The fuzzing technique a corpus runs (`fuzztla run --how`).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.TransitionRecovery
types.summary: The first pass of startup recovery: finishes the durable transitions an interrupted run left behind.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.corpus.VerdictTally
types.summary: A mutable per-verdict count, built up while scanning a corpus and read as `StageEntryCounts`.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.Column
types.summary: A column of a database table.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.CorpusDatabaseException
types.summary: Reports that the corpus database cannot be written.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.CorpusDatabaseSchema
types.summary: The schema of the corpus database, as the corpus-database manual documents it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.CorpusDatabaseWriter
types.summary: Writes the rows of one export into a new SQLite file, in a single transaction.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.CorpusExport
types.summary: Exports a corpus to a new SQLite database, as ADR 0009 defines it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.DatabaseColumns
types.summary: The columns of the database tables.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.DatabaseTable
types.summary: A table of the corpus database: its name, columns and keys.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.EntryBatchExporter
types.summary: Exports listed entry files in chunks.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.EntryRows
types.summary: The rows that one decoded corpus entry contributes: its `entry` row, followed by the rows that reference it: one `knownDefect` row per signature, one `mutationOperator` row per operator, one `stage` row per stage record, one `expr` row per expression construct of its replayed input and one `exprEdge` row per edge between constructs.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.ReplayOutcome
types.summary: The result of analysing one input: what its replay shows, or why it could not be replayed.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.database.Row
types.summary: The values of one row, set by column.

types.summary: Keeps at most a fixed number of quarantined candidates per primary known-defect signature in `00-known-defects`; past the cap, a match is counted by the caller and discarded here.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.input.MetamorphicCandidates
types.summary: Adopts elite conformance entries (ADR 0016 §6): every candidate is the payload of a uniformly drawn parent of a pbt corpus behind the metamorphic header, followed by random rewrite bytes.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.input.MutantCandidates
types.summary: Mutants of the parent pool (ADR 0010): every candidate mutates a uniformly drawn parent, keeps its cohort, and is rejected as a clone when it renders to the parent's module.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.input.ParentPool
types.summary: The entries of `04quality-pass` that a generation mutates or adopts: those of the kind the run generates, read once when the generation starts.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.input.PbtCandidates
types.summary: Property-based candidates (ADR 0002): a target draws one richness cohort, and every candidate for it is a uniformly random byte array of a length from `InputLengthSampler`.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibraryInstall
types.summary: Copies a library's classpath into a corpus, so that the corpus keeps the release it was initialized with.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibraryJson
types.summary: Prunes typechecker JSON to the operator declarations reachable from the selected operators.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibraryManifest
types.summary: Replay policy for external source snapshots.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibraryPreparation
types.summary: Prepares custom libraries once before decoding; no importer/typechecker Maven dependency.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibrarySourceProbe
types.summary: Parses every source alias of a prepared library once, with the classpath the parser and TLC workers receive (ADR 0015).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibrarySources
types.summary: Materializes an ordered module search path as one source-only snapshot for SANY.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.LibraryTypechecker
types.summary: Finite, isolated Snowcat invocation producing a typed module rather than a checker verdict.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.RuleLibraryPreparation
types.summary: Loads the rule module of a metamorphic run once, before decoding (ADR 0017 §1, §6): SANY names its rules and reads their weight annotations, Snowcat types them, and `RewriteLibrary` checks the rule contract.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.library.RuleModuleDefinitions
types.summary: Names the top-level definitions of a rule module itself, in declaration order, with the weight each one's comments annotate (ADR 0017 §1).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.parser.ParserBackend
types.summary: Runs SANY in persistent isolated JVMs, one per stage worker, each replaced after a crash.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.parser.ParserProcess
types.summary: Starts one persistent isolated SANY JVM; the common process handle owns requests and closing.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.parser.ParserRouting
types.summary: Routes parser results.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.parser.ParserWorkerMain
types.summary: Child-process entry point for persistent isolated SANY requests.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.quality.CoverageFeature
types.summary: One operator-coverage feature of an entry's evaluated code (ADR 0013): a construct or an edge between constructs, with the hit-count bucket of its occurrences.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.quality.QualityCell
types.summary: The behaviour cell of an admissible entry (ADR 0013): its TLC verdict and the components of its `QualityKey`, each after its bucket.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.quality.QualityGate
types.summary: Selects the parents of the next generation from one settled generation (ADR 0010, ADR 0013).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.quality.QualityKey
types.summary: The order in which the quality gate ranks admissible entries, best first (ADR 0010).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.quality.SelectionArchive
types.summary: The behaviour cells and coverage features of the entries the gate has kept (ADR 0013), and the rule that decides whether one more entry is kept.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.spec.EvaluatedExprs
types.summary: Replays a stored input and counts the expression constructs of the code the checkers evaluate: the definitions reachable from `SpecArtifact.entryPoints`.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.spec.FuzzInputModule
types.summary: Assembles the module checked by the parser and model-checker stages.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.spec.GeneratedInputPreparation
types.summary: Regenerates and renders one tool input while preserving generator-crash artifacts.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.spec.SpecArtifact
types.summary: One assembled module, what its checkers are asked about it, and what its decoder produced.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.spec.SpecDecoders
types.summary: Immutable registry of the decoders that turn stored payloads into checkable modules.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.spec.SpecText
types.summary: Renders an assembled module as the TLA+ source that the parser and TLC consume.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcCheckerBackend
types.summary: Adapts fresh isolated TLC invocations to the shared tool stage.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcConfiguration
types.summary: The TLC configuration file for one checked module.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcExplorationMetrics
types.summary: Measures one TLC run and attaches the result to its classified outcome (ADR 0008).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcFailureDetail
types.summary: Extracts bounded human-readable context from TLC diagnostics.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcMessageMetrics
types.summary: Follows the messages TLC prints, which say when its initial states are complete and which states its error trace consists of.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcOutcomeClassifier
types.summary: Maps TLC's internal error constants to workflow outcomes.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcProcess
types.summary: Runs one TLC request in a fresh isolated JVM.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcStateMetrics
types.summary: Measures the state graph TLC explores, through the state-writer callbacks TLC makes for every initial state and every generated transition.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcValueShape
types.summary: The shape of the values of one state: how many value nodes they hold, their largest collection, and their deepest nesting.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tlc.TlcWorkerMain
types.summary: One-shot TLC child process.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tool.ProcessToolWorker
types.summary: A tool worker served by one isolated child process until a crash verdict retires it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tool.StageRouting
types.summary: Where a `ToolStage` takes its inputs from, how it bounds its result directories, and where a recorded result goes next.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tool.ToolBackend
types.summary: Tool-specific behavior injected into the shared `ToolStage`.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tool.ToolStage
types.summary: One stage that runs an external tool over corpus entries: the parser, TLC, or Apalache.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.tool.ToolWorker
types.summary: Worker-local tool state used for one or more sequential inputs.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.BoundedOutputCapture
types.summary: Continuously drains a process stream while retaining only a bounded prefix.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.BoundedTextOutputStream
types.summary: Retains a bounded UTF-8 byte prefix while discarding subsequent output.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.CheckRequest
types.summary: What a checker is asked about one assembled module.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ChildJvm
types.summary: The resources and options of one child JVM.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.IsolatedWorkerProcess
types.summary: Parent-side supervisor for one isolated Java tool worker.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.JavaLaunch
types.summary: How this project spells a child JVM launch, so every caller spells it the same way.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.OneShotTool
types.summary: A finite CLI invocation, unlike protocol workers which serve a sequence of per-input requests.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.StageOutcome
types.summary: Common result of processing one input in a checking stage.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.StandardModuleResources
types.summary: Verifies that generated specifications can resolve their packaged standard modules.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ToolInput
types.summary: One rendered specification and what the receiving checker is asked about it.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ToolResult
types.summary: One request result returned by an isolated tool worker.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ToolThreadStacks
types.summary: The stacks of the threads a stopped worker was working on, for the diagnostic of a timeout (ADR 0021).

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ToolWorkerConnection
types.summary: Child-side connection to the parent's private worker-protocol listener.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ToolWorkerProtocol
types.summary: Binary framing shared by isolated parser and model-checker workers.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.ToolWorkerRuntime
types.summary: The part of a child worker that is the same for every tool: report an escaped failure by exiting non-zero, announce itself to the parent, serve inputs until the parent stops asking, write each input where the tool reads it, and keep a bounded record of what the tool printed.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.WorkerChannel
types.summary: The parent's end of one worker's control channel: message framing, and the deadline every read runs under.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.WorkerDiagnostics
types.summary: Diagnostic formatting shared by isolated tool entry points.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.WorkerLaunch
types.summary: Brings one isolated worker up: private scratch storage, a private loopback listener, the child JVM, and an authenticated control connection.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.WorkerOutput
types.summary: Everything a child process says outside the control channel, and the scratch tree it says it in.

types.name: io.github.tlaplus.hardening.workflow.worker.WorkerSpec
types.summary: How to launch one isolated tool worker: where it may write, how long it may take to come up, which class it runs, what goes in front of this JVM's class path, the child JVM it runs in, and what to call it in diagnostics.
